One automation, two trigger kinds: every 30 minutes it polls the inbox for new patient enquiries (drafting a reply via the shared Patient message approval form) and for replies confirming a proposed time (raising a booking-confirmation approval); on that form's submission, it applies the reviewer's decision - creating the Cliniko patient, booking the appointment, emailing the intake form link, or re-offering a time that was taken before approval. Sending the enquiry reply itself is handled by the existing Apply no-show follow-up decision automation, which this reuses unchanged. Shares one Knowledge state file per thread (PracticeManager/EnquiryThreads) tracking enquiry -> patient -> appointment -> form.

import json
import datetime

AI_PROMPT = (
    "Read this reply to a new-patient enquiry email and decide whether it clearly confirms the "
    "originally proposed appointment time, asks for a different time, or doesn't clearly confirm "
    "anything (e.g. a question, or an ambiguous reply). If the reply gives the patient's full name "
    "or date of birth, extract them - otherwise leave blank. Never invent a name, date of birth or "
    "time that wasn't given."
)
AI_HINT = json.dumps({
    "confirms_proposed_time": True,
    "requested_alternative": "",
    "no_clear_time": False,
    "patient_first_name": "",
    "patient_last_name": "",
    "patient_dob": "",
})
AI_CLARIFY_PROMPT = (
    "Write a short, warm clarifying reply for a healthcare clinic, asking the enquirer to confirm "
    "one of the originally offered times (or to suggest another day) because their reply wasn't "
    "clear. Use Australian English and Australian date/time conventions."
)
AI_CLARIFY_HINT = json.dumps({"subject": "", "body": ""})


def read_json(path, default=None):
    try:
        raw = api.files.read(file=path)
    except Exception:
        return default
    try:
        return json.loads(raw)
    except Exception:
        return default


def write_json(path, data):
    api.files.put(file=path, content=json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True))


def audit(slug, action, target, summary, workq_item_id=None):
    if not slug:
        return
    today = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    path = "PracticeManager/AuditLog/" + slug + "-" + today + ".jsonl"
    try:
        existing = api.files.read(file=path)
    except Exception:
        existing = ""
    entry = {
        "ts": datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
        "practice_slug": slug,
        "actor": "agent",
        "source": "automation:New enquiry handling",
        "action": action,
        "target": target,
        "summary": summary,
    }
    if workq_item_id:
        entry["workq_item_id"] = workq_item_id
    line = json.dumps(entry, sort_keys=True)
    api.files.put(file=path, content=(existing + line + "\n") if existing else (line + "\n"))


item = params.get("item") or {}
email_id = item.get("email_id") or ""
thread = item.get("thread") or {}
todo_id = item.get("todo_id") or ""
outcome = "skipped"

if email_id and thread:
    try:
        full = api.connectors.invoke(server="m365-mail-read", tool="get_email", args={"id": email_id})
    except Exception:
        full = None
    full = full if isinstance(full, dict) else {}
    body_block = full.get("body") or {}
    body_content = body_block.get("content") if isinstance(body_block, dict) else str(body_block or "")

    proposed = thread.get("proposed_appointment") or None
    slug = thread.get("slug") or ""

    try:
        parsed = api.ai.extract(
            prompt=AI_PROMPT,
            input=json.dumps({
                "proposed_time": (proposed or {}).get("starts_at") if proposed else "",
                "reply_body": body_content or "",
            }),
            schema_hint=AI_HINT,
        )
    except Exception:
        parsed = {}
    parsed = parsed if isinstance(parsed, dict) else {}

    enquirer_name = thread.get("enquirer_name") or "the enquirer"
    name_parts = enquirer_name.split(" ", 1)
    first_name = str(parsed.get("patient_first_name") or "").strip() or name_parts[0]
    last_name = str(parsed.get("patient_last_name") or "").strip() or (name_parts[1] if len(name_parts) > 1 else "")

    if proposed and parsed.get("confirms_proposed_time") and not parsed.get("no_clear_time"):
        description = (
            "**Enquirer:** " + enquirer_name + " (" + (thread.get("enquirer_email") or "") + ")  \n"
            "**Confirmed time:** " + str(proposed.get("starts_at") or "") + "  \n"
            "**Reason given:** " + (thread.get("reason_for_visit") or "not stated") + "  \n\n"
            "Approving this will create the patient in Cliniko, book the appointment, send the intake "
            "form (if one is configured for this practice) and email a confirmation.\n\n"
            "**Confirmation email:**\n\nHi " + first_name + ", you're all booked in for "
            + str(proposed.get("starts_at") or "") + ". We'll be in touch if anything else is needed "
            "before your visit."
        )
        workq_item = api.workq.create(
            title="Confirm booking: " + enquirer_name,
            scope="org",
            description=description,
            priority="normal",
            assignee_ids=[thread.get("reviewer_id")] if thread.get("reviewer_id") else None,
            labels=["healthcare-practice-management", "new-enquiry", "booking-confirmation"],
        )
        new_todo_id = workq_item["id"]
        api.workq.attach_form(todo_id=new_todo_id, form_id=params["approval_form"])
        write_json("PracticeManager/BookingDrafts/" + new_todo_id + ".json", {
            "slug": slug,
            "thread_todo_id": todo_id,
            "enquirer_email": thread.get("enquirer_email") or "",
            "first_name": first_name,
            "last_name": last_name,
            "dob": (str(parsed.get("patient_dob")) if parsed.get("patient_dob") else None),
            "appointment_type_id": proposed.get("appointment_type_id") or "",
            "business_id": proposed.get("business_id") or "",
            "practitioner_id": proposed.get("practitioner_id") or "",
            "starts_at": proposed.get("starts_at") or "",
            "intake_form_template_id": thread.get("intake_form_template_id") or "",
        })
        thread["status"] = "booking_approval_raised"
        write_json("PracticeManager/EnquiryThreads/" + todo_id + ".json", thread)
        audit(slug, "drafted", {"kind": "booking", "id": new_todo_id}, "Raised a booking-confirmation approval for " + enquirer_name, new_todo_id)
        outcome = "booking_approval_raised"
    else:
        # No clear time, or an alternative was requested - draft a clarifying reply through the same
        # approve-and-send mechanism rather than a dead-end manual item, and keep the thread open.
        alt = str(parsed.get("requested_alternative") or "").strip()
        try:
            clarify = api.ai.extract(
                prompt=AI_CLARIFY_PROMPT,
                input=json.dumps({
                    "enquirer_name": enquirer_name,
                    "proposed_time": (proposed or {}).get("starts_at") if proposed else "",
                    "requested_alternative": alt,
                    "their_reply": body_content or "",
                }),
                schema_hint=AI_CLARIFY_HINT,
            )
        except Exception:
            clarify = {}
        clarify = clarify if isinstance(clarify, dict) else {}
        clarify_subject = clarify.get("subject") or "Just confirming your appointment time"
        clarify_body = clarify.get("body") or (
            "Hi " + enquirer_name + ", just checking - does " + (str((proposed or {}).get("starts_at") or "")) + " work for you, "
            "or would another day suit better?"
        )

        workq_item = api.workq.create(
            title="New enquiry: " + enquirer_name + " (needs a clarifying reply)",
            scope="org",
            description=(
                "**Enquirer:** " + enquirer_name + " (" + (thread.get("enquirer_email") or "") + ")  \n"
                + ("**Asked for a different time:** " + alt + "  \n" if alt else "")
                + "\n\n**Their reply:**\n\n" + (body_content or "")[:2000]
                + "\n\n**Drafted clarifying reply:**\n\n" + clarify_body
            ),
            priority="normal",
            assignee_ids=[thread.get("reviewer_id")] if thread.get("reviewer_id") else None,
            labels=["healthcare-practice-management", "new-enquiry"],
        )
        clarify_todo_id = workq_item["id"]
        api.workq.attach_form(todo_id=clarify_todo_id, form_id=params["approval_form"])
        write_json("PracticeManager/NoShowDrafts/" + clarify_todo_id + ".json", {
            "slug": slug,
            "appointment_id": "",
            "patient_id": "",
            "patient_name": enquirer_name,
            "email": thread.get("enquirer_email") or "",
            "subject": clarify_subject,
            "body": clarify_body,
        })
        # Thread stays "awaiting_reply" - the next reply to this clarifying question is picked up the same way.
        audit(slug, "drafted", {"kind": "email", "id": clarify_todo_id}, "Drafted a clarifying reply to " + enquirer_name, clarify_todo_id)
        outcome = "clarifying_reply_drafted"
